Container.Name: JusttPrint
Container.Overview: A self-hosted library for your 3D printing models (STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP, ZIP and more), used from any browser on your network. It scans your model folders, renders thumbnails, and keeps tags, designers, licenses, categories, collections, print history, printers and kits in one place, with accounts for family or a makerspace.[br][br] Choose a [b]Password[/b] (user name [i]admin[/i]); leave it empty and a random password is printed once in the container log. Then open the WebUI: JusttPrint asks which folders hold your models and scans them. Change them later under Settings, Scanning, STL Home.[br][br] [b]Unraid Shares[/b] makes your shares visible at the same paths (/mnt/user/...), read and write, so delete, move and Organize Library work. Unraid's own shares (appdata, system, domains, isos) are never scanned or shown. To limit JusttPrint to one share, set both the host path and the container path to it, for example /mnt/user/models.[br][br] Settings given here win over the web UI on every start; leave one empty to set it in the web UI instead.[br][br] [b]NVIDIA GPU (optional, faster thumbnails):[/b] with the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and the variables NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=graphics,compute,utility.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database, thumbnails, settings and backups. Keep this folder: it holds your library.

Config.Name: Unraid Shares
Config.Description: Your shares, at the same paths inside the container; pick the model folders in the web UI. For one share only, change BOTH paths to it, for example host /mnt/user/models and container /mnt/user/models.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account, applied on every start (also how to reset a forgotten one). Empty: a random password is printed once in the container log.

Config.Name: User Name
Config.Description: User name of the admin account. Other accounts are added under Settings, Authentication, Users.

Config.Name: STL Home
Config.Description: Optional: folders to scan, for example /mnt/user/models,/mnt/user/archive. Empty: choose them in the web UI. Folders added or removed here are added or removed on the next start; folders chosen in the web UI stay.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 is Unraid's nobody). Files it writes get this owner.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 is Unraid's users).

Config.Name: Upload Folder
Config.Description: Folder every upload and every download from a model link goes to, for example /mnt/user/upload (made if missing). Organize moves the models from it. Empty: set it in the web UI (Settings, Scanning, Organize).

Config.Name: Organize Destination
Config.Description: Where Organize puts models (Category/Subcategory/Title), for example /mnt/user. Empty: the first STL Home folder, or set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Scan ZIP Files
Config.Description: true or false: also scan the models inside ZIP files. Empty: set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Extra File Types
Config.Description: Extra file types to scan, for example obj,step,ply,gcode.

Config.Name: Skip Folders
Config.Description: Folders inside STL Home to skip, for example /mnt/user/models/cache.

Config.Name: Guest Access
Config.Description: true: people who open JusttPrint without logging in can browse like a Viewer. Empty: set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Automatic Backups
Config.Description: true or false: back up the database automatically (into backups in App Data). Empty: set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Backups to Keep
Config.Description: How many automatic backups to keep (default 7). Empty: set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: AI Service
Config.Description: For AI tagging: openai, claude, gemini, puter or custom. Can also be set in the web UI.

Config.Name: AI API Key
Config.Description: API key for the AI service (never written to the log).

Config.Name: AI Model
Config.Description: AI model name, for example gpt-5-nano.

Config.Name: AI Endpoint
Config.Description: Address of the AI service for custom, for example a local Ollama server.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Your public address when behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager), for example https://library.example.com.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front (usually 1). Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: Thumbnail Rendering
Config.Description: auto uses an NVIDIA GPU when one is passed in, else the CPU (swiftshader).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: How much the container log shows.
